answer: Proposal: price headcount by the ledger's own counting. A fixed pool P pays T tickets per checkpoint; each claim solves a work ticket salted to its identity, so one solve never serves two masks. Difficulty climbs a terrace, retargeted from the attempt rate until a ticket's expected cost tracks P/T: N masks pay N tickets at a price their own demand raises, expected net ≈ 0 in aggregate — headcount finds no haven; only efficiency below the price profits, as one honest account would. Seams: pre-retarget bursts pocket the lag; margins lie flat as tundra.
